cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(XLVPX LANGUAGES C)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}" XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/sources.cmake")
add_library(vpx STATIC ${XL_VPX_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(vpx PRIVATE "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
target_compile_definitions(vpx PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
target_link_libraries(vpx PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(vpx PRIVATE /utf-8)
else()
  target_link_libraries(vpx PRIVATE m)
endif()
install(TARGETS vpx ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
install(DIRECTORY "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}/vpx/" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/vpx FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.h")
install(FILES "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}/LICENSE" "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}/PATENTS" DESTINATION share/licenses/libvpx)
